SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
  SELECT MIN(element_count)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS element_count
    FROM atom AS a2
    JOIN molecule AS m2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
    WHERE m2.label = '-'
    GROUP BY a2.element
  )
)
ORDER BY a.element ASC
